SELECT r.REPORT_ID AS reportId, u.NICKNAME AS reporterNickname, r.REPORT_TYPE AS reportType, r.REASON AS reason, r.STATUS AS status, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM REPORT r JOIN USERS u ON r.USER_ID = u.NO ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 5
